findings.title: Readiness probe failing
findings.cause: container web's readiness probe has the command line "cat /tmp/ready" as one item, so the kubelet looks for a program with that whole name, spaces included, and there is none: an exec probe's command is a list of arguments, and no shell splits it, so the probe can never pass and the container gets no traffic; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): Readiness probe errored and resulted in unknown state: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to exec in container: failed to start exec "2ee17e4b90323cb757d1519b1f6ece24a86a743158e44dd8b4c9a68c2f8f442d": OCI runtime exec failed: exec failed: unable to start container process: exec: "cat /tmp/ready": stat cat /tmp/ready: no such file or directory

evidence.what: container web is running but not ready

findings.fix: Write each word of the probe's command as its own item: command: ["cat", "/tmp/ready"]. If it needs a pipe, && or a variable, run it through a shell: ["sh", "-c", "cat /tmp/ready"].
